# MBMS Podcast Studio

> London podcast production studio. We record, edit, publish and promote podcasts for businesses, and help them turn each episode into clips, posts and articles for their wider marketing.

MBMS Podcast Studio is run by Damien. We record at venues in London including Hale House, bring a RØDE mobile studio to clients' offices and events, and record remote guests with Riverside.

## Services and guide prices

- Recording session: £250 for up to 90 minutes, including studio preparation, sound check, monitoring and raw audio files
- Audio editing: from £175 per episode
- Audio and video editing: from £350 per episode
- Edited transcripts: from £85 per episode
- Show notes and episode descriptions: from £95 per episode
- Uploading, scheduling and distribution across the major podcast platforms
- Complete package (recording, editing, show notes, distribution and three social clips): from around £950 per episode
- Monthly packages for regular customers
- Social clips for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, supporting posts and articles, and campaign alignment

Prices are guidelines, not fixed rates.
